fields.Name: IT64 - View Security (two-identity RLS)
fields.Description: Two-identity view security invariants (Domain 11 V14/V15/V16 + RV17) using the seeded scoped principals: VS1 saved-view WHERE AND-combines with the running user's RLS clause (≡ scoped dynamic control, ⊆ admin); VS2 a private view run by a non-owner is refused or B-scoped with the looseness surfaced; VS3 a shared view executes for a non-owner with the NON-OWNER's scope; VS4 COUNT(*) aggregates carry WHERE+RLS. Loud skip on an all-admin DB. 4 checks VS1-VS4, mutation-gated fixtures.
